prompt: State the direction in which a frictional force acts between two solid surfaces in contact.

mark_scheme.criterion: Parallel to the contacting surfaces and opposing the relative motion (or tendency of relative motion) between them.

hints: State the orientation relative to the interface (parallel or perpendicular).
State what type of motion it opposes (use the word relative).
solution: Parallel to the contacting surfaces, opposing the relative motion between them.
teacher_walkthrough: Friction acts parallel to the contact interface.
The critical requirement is that it opposes relative motion between the surfaces.
Award B1 for stating parallel to surfaces and opposing relative motion.
